priority_reason: This is the cheapest high-information discriminator in the admitted G2 order. A valid failure can falsify the fully-local premise before spending time on partial-streaming, producer-preemption or long-session stress.
reuse_only: already-pinned Nemotron 3.5 ASR local runtime/model subject
already-accepted local Piper/Kokoro-Piper TTS path or exact current accepted successor
execution_fences: Refresh main immediately before binding the exact execution subject.
Use one disposable positively identified S1/S2 VPS sandbox; do not use the owner workstation.
Prestage every required model/runtime artifact before network isolation.
Disable external network at the container/network-namespace layer, e.g. rootless Podman --network=none or the current admitted equivalent.

Verify the network fence independently before inference: record namespace/interface/route state and execute one bounded expected-failure outbound TCP probe. A language-level socket monkeypatch alone is insufficient.
Do not download packages/models or contact any external model/ASR/TTS API after the promotion-bearing network fence becomes active.
Bind exact F2 source SHA, executable/runtime hashes and model/config hashes into the receipt.
Preserve host survival, disk/RAM/PID headroom and cleanup boundaries.
minimum_execution: Enter the isolated sandbox and prove the network-none fence is active.
Run one real local German ASR inference from a prestaged admitted audio fixture.
Run one real local German TTS inference from a fixed deterministic text through the accepted local producer.
Bind the produced transcript and PCM/WAV hash to the exact local runtime/model identities.
Record external model/ASR/TTS API calls observed = 0.
Exit and destroy only sandbox-local disposable state.
pass_invariants: The sandbox has no usable external network during the promotion-bearing inference window.
Real local ASR executes successfully from prestaged artifacts.
Real local TTS executes successfully from prestaged artifacts.
No hidden remote inference dependency is required.
next_exact_action_if_pass: Do not repeat FDX12. Advance the same G2 semantic owner to G2A_TRUE_PARTIAL_STREAMING_ASR, then G2B producer-side preemption/FDX9. Add the actual PipeWire virtual-sink monitor/readback discriminator to G2B before claiming any graph-delivery cancellation evidence beyond the existing run-local sink bookkeeping scope.
next_exact_action_if_nonproduct_failure: Repair only the execution/evidence surface and retry the same exact semantic subject when valid; do not mutate Voice architecture.
next_exact_action_if_product_negative: Preserve the exact negative receipt and route only the smallest causal dependency repair to Trigger 4 before any new model/component breadth.
